title: GTM conductor: model catalog sequencing and release-notes coordination
creator: Sofia Kim
description: Purpose: Provide a sequenced, cross-functional playbook for adding a new model to the Redwood model catalog that ensures benchmark validity, docs and SDK updates, console entry, release notes, and GTM comms are completed and coordinated. Scope covers hosted catalog entry, public release notes, developer docs, benchmark publication, console tile and dashboard, SDK examples, and announcement assets. Excludes Dedicated/private deployment rollout steps beyond a separate private onboarding checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark results published to the public benchmarks dashboard and meet quality targets (per-bucket latency and perplexity thresholds documented)
Developer docs + SDK example updated and published in docs site with code sample for text generation and embeddings
Console model card and pricing tile live in staging and verified by support and docs owners
Release notes draft in GitHub and Confluence approved by PM + Legal + Support
Release checklist completed: PRs merged, release artifacts provisioned, monitoring dashboards in place, rollback policy defined

rollout_steps: Canary (internal + limited customers): enable model for 5% of requests routed in region-1 for 48h — monitor latency, error rate, quality metrics
Expanded canary: 25% routing for 24h if canary stable — monitor billing/cost spike and perf regressions
Full rollout: 100% in hosted catalog in region-1, then stagger region-2 after 72h stability
Dedicated availability: publish model artifact and guide for Dedicated customers; sales-assisted onboarding as needed
Fallback policy: auto-route to smaller/lower-cost variant on latency or OOM events according to runtime policy
communication_plan: Pre-announce to Beta customers + key partners 72h before public launch via email and Slack
Publish release notes and changelog entry at launch time; include example API calls and migration notes
Blog post with benchmarks and recommended usage patterns within 48h of launch
Update SDK changelog + release a patch if code examples changed
Internal all-hands/weekly update for Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering with Q&A
Post-launch: 1-week follow-up metrics email to internal channels summarizing adoption and notable incidents
risks_mitigation: Quality regression: maintain quick rollback plan and a set of regression test prompts; gate rollout on passing automatic evals
Performance spike: keep autoscaling limits and burst capacity pre-configured; infra to reserve buffer for first 72h
Docs drift: require docs PR merged before public catalog tile goes live; block release if missing examples
Legal/Policy flag: early legal review of release notes language; include opt-out guidance for customers if model has sensitive behaviors
Support ramp: prepare triage runbook and on-call rotation for first 7 days post-launch
